label: Fever
design: Upright thermometer with heat marks

label: A low fever
design: Upright thermometer with a short mercury line and two tiny horizontal heat ticks.

label: Coughing or wheezing
design: Simple human side-profile head and neck with two short curved airflow lines leaving the mouth.

label: Dark urine or clay-colored stools
design: Two clean symbolic shapes: a navy outlined urine droplet with solid small center, beside a simple rounded stool outline; restrained medical shorthand, not graphic.

label: Diarrhea or vomiting
design: Simple stomach outline with a downward flow arrow and one small upward curved flow cue; one unified digestive glyph.

label: Diarrhea, which may be bloody
design: Simple intestine-loop outline with a downward flow arrow and one small droplet; monochrome, no graphic blood.

label: Difficulty breathing
design: Paired lung outline, central trachea, two short broken airflow curves beside one lung.

label: Difficulty swallowing
design: Minimal side-profile head and neck, small throat dot, downward arrow interrupted by one short crossbar.

label: Dizziness or fainting
design: Simple tilted human head with one small curved spiral arc above it.

label: Double or blurred vision
design: Simple eye outline, two slightly offset pupil outlines suggesting double vision without a crossed-out eye.

label: Drooping eyelids
design: Simple eye with a visibly lowered upper eyelid and partial iris; no crossed-out eye.

label: Feeling tired
design: Minimal human head and slumped shoulder silhouette, small two-line rest cue.

label: Feeling very tired
design: Minimal human head bent slightly forward and slumped shoulders, small two-line rest cue.

label: Headache
design: Simple side-profile head with a small three-ray pain mark at temple.

label: Headache, stiff neck, or confusion
design: Minimal side-profile head and neck, tiny pain rays at temple and one small interrupted curve at neck; no question mark text.

label: Hives or flushed skin
design: Simple forearm and hand outline with three circular raised spots on forearm.

label: Increased gas
design: Simple stomach outline containing two small bubbles with one outward curved air cue.

label: Joint pain
design: Simple bent knee joint outline with a small three-ray pain mark at hinge.

label: Loss of appetite
design: Simple plate with fork beside it and one small horizontal minus mark; no weight scale.

label: Loss of appetite and weight loss
design: Small simple plate and fork with a restrained downward arrow, one cohesive icon.

label: Muscle aches or fatigue
design: Simple bent upper arm muscle outline with small pain rays and a relaxed drooping angle.

label: Muscle weakness
design: Simple bent arm outline with a short downward arrow beside it; no pain rays.

label: Nausea
design: Simple stomach outline with two small wavy lines inside.

label: Nausea or vomiting
design: Simple stomach outline with one wavy line inside and a small upward curved arrow.

label: Nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain
design: Simple stomach outline with a small upward flow cue and tiny lightning pain mark.

label: Slurred speech
design: Simple side-profile mouth and small speech bubble containing two gently wavering lines, no letters.

label: Stomach cramps or bloating
design: Simple stomach outline with tiny lightning mark and one outward expansion curve.

label: Stomach cramps, which can be severe
design: Simple stomach outline with one prominent small lightning pain mark.

label: Tingling or swelling of the mouth, face, or throat
design: Simple side-profile face and throat with three tiny sensory rays near lips and one curved swelling contour.

label: Trouble breathing
design: Paired lung outline, central trachea, two short broken airflow curves beside one lung.

label: Vomiting
design: Simple side-profile head, mouth angled slightly downward with short outward downward flow arrow; not graphic, no actual vomit.

label: Vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach cramps
design: Simple stomach outline with small upward and downward flow cues and restrained tiny lightning mark, uncluttered.

label: Watery diarrhea
design: Simple intestine loop outline with downward arrow ending beside two tiny water drops.

label: Yellow skin or eyes
design: Simple eye outline with an iris surrounded by three short radiating marks to suggest a visible change; monochrome navy, no yellow color.
